findings.location: docs/feature/bug-6665-former-parents-stranded/acceptance.md ### S1 row 9 (Disposition NotTested, owner design) and Lighthouse.Backend.Tests/API/PortfolioControllerTest.cs (no support)
findings.obligation: P3: deleting a Portfolio removes its Features from Team pages at once; the in-app trigger (PortfolioController.DeletePortfolio publishes PortfolioDeleted after the save) must be falsifiable
findings.observation: Row 9 says: 'No declared support observes the controller's queued delete ... a new host scenario is not allowed here'. A host-free observation exists: PortfolioControllerTest already builds the controller with a Mock<IUpdateQueueService> in CreateSubject, and TeamControllerTest.Delete_PublishesTeamDeletedEvent shows running the queued lambda against a mocked IDomainEventDispatcher. Without it, a controller that never publishes (or publishes before the save) leaves DomainEventHandlerOrderPinTest and both handler tests green while P3 is broken in the product.
findings.remediation: Add a support test in PortfolioControllerTest (e.g. DeletePortfolio_PublishesPortfolioDeletedForThatPortfolioAfterTheSave): mock EnqueueAndAwaitAsync to invoke the lambda with a provider holding mocked IRepository<Portfolio>, IRefreshLogService and IDomainEventDispatcher, assert Remove, Save then PublishAsync(PortfolioDeleted{PortfolioId}) in that order (MockSequence), finding the event type by name like the other S1 tests so the project still compiles. Declare it as a support and change row 9 to Tested, with the controller line in the Obligations.
